payload.reason: The evidence discusses the lack of actual exposed MIS 5e facies in certain contexts, indicating preservation bias and variability in sedimentation scenarios.

claims.text: Actual exposed MIS 5e facies are lacking in synthetic well logs, indicating a preservation bias in the geological record.
The limited record of LIG reef facies in some scenarios suggests that lower relative sea level and shorter inundation durations affect preservation.
Isolated pockets of preserved MIS 5e corals indicate that while some facies exist, they are not consistently found across all locations.
